The CPU saturation criterion is 0.9 x GOMAXPROCS. With --gomaxprocs above nproc (the PR body's own GOMAXPROCS 3 on 2 cores) or a cpu.max quota below it, the threshold is unreachable, so a pegged Dispatch is reported not saturated. Use 0.9 x min(GOMAXPROCS, nproc, ceil(cpu.max quota/period)) and record the figure. The timeout and in-flight criteria stay as they are.
